title: 永恩·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 黑发衬着红色上半脸面具，深红层叠衣装旁保留两把静置长剑。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Yone is an adult swordsman with long black hair, a distinctive red upper-face mask, dark red layered clothing, and two swords. His fully covering wrapped tunic, long sleeves, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots replace exposed torso areas; the steel blade and red spirit blade remain in their separate sheaths.
art_direction.scene: An eye-level three-quarter turn, face off center, a sweeping contour linking the head to the defining motif in open pale paper. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: crimson, lilac pencil shadow, ivory edge light, blue; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
